description: A new step-04 requirement that no later step uses yet: pending until the furthest step that can use its kind (DOC 13.9 row 3).

value.statement: The system shall let a registered member download the data held about their account.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a registered member, when an export is requested, then a file with their account data is offered for download.
Given an export that is ready, when the member downloads it, then the file holds only their own account data.
Given an export older than seven days, when the member opens its link, then the request is rejected.
